messages:
Lauren Kim: quick heads-up 1  saw two orientation events on my calendar (one Zoom, one Meet). which one is the real one?
Omar Ali: canonical = Zoom from onboarding@redwood.com. the Meet copy is a calendar sync quirk for some domains. decline/delete the Meet event.
Tess Morgan: I accepted the Meet by accident  whats the easiest way to fix?
Devon Park: decline should remove it. if its stuck, delete the event and accept the onboarding calendar invite directly (link in the email).
Lauren Kim: also the subject says "09:00 PST" which confused a candidate who thought PST != PT. can we switch to PT label?
Omar Ali: yes 1 done last week across onboarding events. new subject format: "Orientation  09:00 PT / 17:00 BST / 21:30 IST". that should help.
Calendar Sync Bot: Automated: Removed duplicate Google Meet attachment for event ID e3b2. Updated title per request.
Tess Morgan: thanks. will the session be recorded? some folks in APAC want a replay.
Onboarding Bot: Recording: yes. Will be uploaded to the onboarding bucket ~30-60 minutes after session ends. Transcript + auto-captions (English) enabled. Retention: 60 days. For translated captions or extended retention, email onboarding@redwood.com.
Devon Park: where do slides live?
Omar Ali: Slides in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Redwood_Onboard_v3. Recording link posted separately in the calendar event and onboarding channel after upload.
Lauren Kim: small request  can we add a short pre-session checklist to the calendar (VPN, Slack, laptop image installs)? new hires keep DMing about it.
Omar Ali: added checklist and a short note about APAC replay times + link to alternate live sessions. also added a line: "If you manually imported .ics, delete duplicates and re-accept onboarding calendar."
Tess Morgan: any quick steps to force timezone re-sync for people who imported .ics?
Devon Park: best is delete the manually imported event, then accept the invite from the onboarding calendar. or go to Calendar Settings > Time zone and ensure your local tz is set, then refresh.
Lauren Kim: perfect. one last ask  can the subject include both PT label and the Zoom link host so it's obvious? sometimes email clients hide attachments.
Omar Ali: added Zoom link in the event subject and description: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 passcode: Onb0ard. note: do not share externally.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder scheduled: 24 hours and 15 minutes before. Recording will include slides + presenter video.
Tess Morgan: great, ive cleaned up my calendar and re-accepted the onboarding invite. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
